mapper.select: SELECT chat_session_no, anonymous_id, user_no, scenario_no, version_no, current_node_no, session_type, state, started_at, last_activity_at, expires_at, ip_hash, user_agent_hash, frst_reg_dt FROM tb_chat_session WHERE chat_session_no = #{id}::uuid
mapper.sql: s.chat_session_no, left(s.chat_session_no::text, 8) AS session_key, s.scenario_no, COALESCE(sc.title, CHR(44160) || CHR(49353)) AS scenario_title, s.state, s.current_node_no, s.started_at, s.last_activity_at, s.expires_at, COALESCE(count(m.chat_message_no), 0) AS message_count, ( SELECT lm.content FROM tb_chat_message lm WHERE lm.session_no = s.chat_session_no ORDER BY lm.seq DESC, lm.chat_message_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message, ( SELECT lm.content_ciphertext FROM tb_chat_message lm WHERE lm.session_no = s.chat_session_no ORDER BY lm.seq DESC, lm.chat_message_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message_ciphertext, ( SELECT lm.content_key_id FROM tb_chat_message lm WHERE lm.session_no = s.chat_session_no ORDER BY lm.seq DESC, lm.chat_message_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message_key_id, ( SELECT lm.content_encryption_version FROM tb_chat_message lm WHERE lm.session_no = s.chat_session_no ORDER BY lm.seq DESC, lm.chat_message_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message_encryption_version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_chat_session s LEFT JOIN tb_scenario sc ON sc.scenario_no = s.scenario_no LEFT JOIN tb_chat_message m ON m.session_no = s.chat_session_no WHERE s.anonymous_id = #{anonymousId}::uuid AND s.user_no IS NULL AND s.frst_reg_dt >= #{cutoff} GROUP BY s.chat_session_no, sc.title ORDER BY s.last_activity_at DESC, s.chat_session_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM tb_chat_session s LEFT JOIN tb_scenario sc ON sc.scenario_no = s.scenario_no LEFT JOIN tb_chat_message m ON m.session_no = s.chat_session_no GROUP BY s.chat_session_no, sc.title ORDER BY s.last_activity_at DESC, s.chat_session_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM tb_chat_session s LEFT JOIN tb_scenario sc ON sc.scenario_no = s.scenario_no LEFT JOIN tb_chat_message m ON m.session_no = s.chat_session_no WHERE s.chat_session_no = #{id}::uuid GROUP BY s.chat_session_no, sc.title
WITH lock AS ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('chat_session:' || #{sessionId}::text)) ) SELECT 1 FROM lock
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_chat_session SET current_node_no = #{currentNodeId}, state = #{state}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, last_activity_at = now() WHERE chat_session_no = #{id}::uuid

UPDATE tb_chat_session SET scenario_no = #{scenarioNo}, version_no = #{versionNo}, current_node_no = #{currentNodeNo}, session_type = #{sessionType}, state = #{state}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, last_activity_at = now() WHERE chat_session_no = #{id}::uuid

UPDATE tb_chat_session SET scenario_no = NULL, version_no = NULL, current_node_no = NULL, session_type = 'SEARCH', state = 'ACTIVE', expires_at = #{expiresAt}, last_activity_at = now() WHERE chat_session_no = #{id}::uuid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_chat_session_event ( session_no, event_type, from_scenario_no, to_scenario_no, trigger_message_no, detail ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}::uuid, 'SCENARIO_SWITCH', #{fromScenarioNo}, #{toScenarioNo}, #{triggerMessageNo}, CAST(#{detail} AS jsonb) )
mapper.select: SELECT trigger_message_no FROM tb_chat_session_event WHERE session_no = #{sessionId}::uuid AND event_type = 'SCENARIO_SWITCH' AND to_scenario_no = #{toScenarioNo} AND trigger_message_no IS NOT NULL ORDER BY chat_session_event_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (detail ->> 'restoredFromMessageNo')::bigint FROM tb_chat_session_event WHERE session_no = #{sessionId}::uuid AND event_type = 'SEARCH_BACK' AND trigger_message_no = #{triggerMessageNo} AND detail ->> 'restoredFromMessageNo' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY chat_session_event_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_chat_session_event ( session_no, event_type, from_scenario_no, trigger_message_no, detail ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}::uuid, 'SEARCH_BACK', #{fromScenarioNo}, #{triggerMessageNo}, CAST(#{detail} AS jsonb) )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_chat_session SET state = 'EXPIRED', last_activity_at = now() WHERE chat_session_no = #{id}::uuid AND state = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE tb_chat_session SET state = 'EXPIRED', last_activity_at = now() WHERE state = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at < #{cutoff}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_chat_session s LEFT JOIN tb_scenario sc ON sc.scenario_no=s.scenario_no LEFT JOIN tb_chat_message m ON m.session_no=s.chat_session_no WHERE s.user_no=#{userNo} AND s.frst_reg_dt >= #{cutoff} GROUP BY s.chat_session_no,sc.title ORDER BY s.last_activity_at DESC,s.chat_session_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}
